units: <cite ref="Yoma 84a:10">Yoma 84ᵃ</cite> <he>מקיזין דם לס׳ בשבת</he> you may let blood on the Sabbath in a case of asphyxia.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 37b:5">Snh. 37ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 30b:1">Keth. 30ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sotah 8b:14">Sot. 8ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:6">Num. R. s. 14</cite> <he>מת בס׳</he> will die from suffocation.—Cmp. <cite ref="O01644"><he>סרנק</he></cite>.
